payload.reason: The evidence provides specific prior approaches for style transfer that were tested, including a rule-based method, Multi-Attribute Style Transfer (MAST), and Adversarial Style Transfer (AdvST).

claims.text: The tested prior approaches for style transfer include a rule-based method, Multi-Attribute Style Transfer (MAST), and Adversarial Style Transfer (AdvST).
The rule-based method aims for style preservation by replacing content-related tokens without modifying other parts of the reference sentence.
Multi-Attribute Style Transfer (MAST) uses back-translation and auxiliary losses to handle multiple attributes in style transfer.
Adversarial Style Transfer (AdvST) combines back-translation with adversarial training to disentangle content and style representations.
